name: lexin-chrome-extension
description: Swedish to other languages dictionary. Powered by Lexin and Folkets Lexikon

scripts.build:copy: cp -r src/css dist/ && cp -r src/html dist/ && cp -r src/icons dist/ && npm run build:manifest
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:bundle && npm run build:copy
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npx playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run build && npx playwright test --headed
scripts.test:e2e:debug: npm run build && npx playwright test --debug
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build && npx playwright test --ui
